title: HealthEducationDraft
description: Internal AI draft for lifestyle_guidance; patient advice is rendered to the existing public-health.v1 text section, while risk analysis, evidence, missingFacts and doctorNotes become result.warnings in a separate physician-only panel. No new PHIS field. Risk concern is qualitative, not a calibrated risk probability.

missingFacts.description: 缺失资料说明，仅医生区展示，不进入患者章节正文。

doctorNotes.description: 内部医生提醒；校验后移入 result.warnings，仅医生区展示，不进入患者章节或 PHIS 确认正文。

modelTextBoundary.description: Applies to model text only, not the renderer's original evidence values. Keeps weight-management content and clinical units out of this independent follow-up draft; not a medical review.
